+def smooth_path(points: list[tuple[float, float]], samples_per_leg: int = 12) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Cubic Hermite interpolation through the hand-traced target points."""
+    p = np.asarray(points, dtype=np.float64)
+    tangent = np.empty_like(p)
+    tangent[0] = p[1] - p[0]
+    tangent[-1] = p[-1] - p[-2]
+    tangent[1:-1] = (p[2:] - p[:-2]) * 0.5
+    out = []
+    for i in range(len(p) - 1):
+        a, b = p[i], p[i + 1]
+        m0, m1 = tangent[i], tangent[i + 1]
+        for t in np.linspace(0, 1, samples_per_leg, endpoint=False):
+            t2, t3 = t * t, t * t * t
+            h00, h10 = 2*t3 - 3*t2 + 1, t3 - 2*t2 + t
+            h01, h11 = -2*t3 + 3*t2, t3 - t2
+            out.append(h00*a + h10*m0 + h01*b + h11*m1)
+    out.append(p[-1])
+    return np.asarray(out)

+    ds = np.linalg.norm(np.diff(points, axis=0), axis=1)

+    n = max(2, int(math.ceil(arc[-1] / spacing)) + 1)
+    target = np.linspace(0, arc[-1], n)
+    x = np.interp(target, arc, points[:, 0])
+    y = np.interp(target, arc, points[:, 1])
+    return np.c_[x, y], target
